assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE tiny fantasy strategy game Rankings navigation icon on genuinely transparent background. Primary request: replace the previous crown idea with the ASCENDING STONE BAR CHART motif in the user's Travian reference (image 1). Image 1 is the subject/composition reference: a compact staircase-like group of five adjacent upright rectangular columns rising steadily from short on the left to tallest on the right, warm parchment-beige stone front faces, lighter ivory top facets, dark muted brown side faces. Images 2 and 3 are Peris City and Reports icons: match their small tangible illustrated low-poly object style, soft warm upper-left lighting, clean readable shape and restrained natural material colors. Original artwork, not a pixel copy. Subject: five simple squared sandstone bars in ascending heights, with consistent narrow gaps and all bottoms aligned on one baseline. Slight three-quarter depth, mostly frontal so the ascending silhouette is immediately obvious. Matte beige/sandstone, subtle bevels and soft brown shadows between the blocks. Strong simple readable statistics icon at 24px; height values about 25,40,60,80,100 percent. Keep the tallest column on the RIGHT. Centered complete object fills about 80 percent of square. No crown, trophies, gems, shiny gold, people, letters, numbers, labels, axes, grid, arrow, background scenery, platform, border, enclosing circle, button frame, black outline, external shadow, glow or watermark. Keep the background empty and truly transparent. One icon only, no contact sheet.
assets.compositionReference: User-provided Travian statistics screenshot in the conversation, 2026-10-26; ascending bars motif only.
